scope: Evidence for why Drugs@FDA NDA and ANDA products are absent from the current Orange Book product file

fda_documented_absence.basis: FDA states that drug products with tentative approval are not listed in the Orange Book.

interpretation.note: Prescription, over-the-counter, or discontinued Marketing Status alone does not establish why a product is absent from the Orange Book; the Orange Book also contains discontinued products when its inclusion criteria are met.
